description: Multi-source token intelligence: market data, DeFi metrics, contract verification, prediction markets, holder analysis, price history, and AI risk assessment. Aggregates CoinGecko, DeFiLlama, Etherscan, and Polymarket. Free over MCP for 10 calls per day; beyond that the tool returns the pay-per-call x402 endpoint and its price.

include.description: Data modules to include (default: market_data, defi_metrics, contract_info, risk_assessment)

query.description: Token name, symbol, or contract address

name: token_research
